title: Molecular Identification of Dermatophytes by Sequencing ITS Region of Ribosomal RNA
author: Bagchi Anindita
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Collect clinical specimens
steps.instruction: Obtain skin, nail and hair samples from the 150 patients presenting with suspected tinea lesions.

steps.title: Perform direct microscopy
steps.instruction: Examine each collected specimen by direct microscopy to detect fungal elements.

steps.title: Culture for phenotypic ID
steps.instruction: Inoculate the specimens onto appropriate fungal culture media and incubate to allow growth for phenotypic identification of isolates.

steps.title: Genotypic confirmation by PCR
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from the cultured isolates and carry out PCR amplification targeting the internal transcribed spacer (ITS) region to confirm fungal genotype.

steps.title: Sequence ITS region
steps.instruction: Subject the PCR products to DNA sequencing of the ITS region of ribosomal RNA to achieve strain‑level identification.
